A [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] '''strike team''' [[Infiltration of Geonosis Imperial base|attempted to infiltrate]] an [[Geonosis Imperial base|Imperial base]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. The team was captured, but later [[Mission to Geonosis (Galactic Civil War)|rescued]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] and [[X2]]. The survivors would go on to form [[Grey Squadron]] under X2.
